reason: A desktop pet plugin that overlays an animated character in the web interface, reflects Agent activity, supports basic interaction, and plays a completion sound.

summaries.zh: 在 Web 界面中显示会随 Agent 工作状态变化的可互动桌宠，并在任务完成时播放提示音。
summaries.en: Displays an interactive animated desktop pet in the web interface that reflects Agent activity and plays a completion sound when tasks finish.

capabilities: Displays an animated desktop pet overlay in the web interface
Polls Agent status and responds to work, waiting, error, idle, and completion states
Plays a configured completion sound through a host operating-system command
Supports dragging and clicking the pet
Provides a debugging tool for internal state and polling health
